kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

lines.say: Good morning. Ask for this before the day starts.
lines.small: Ask for this before the day starts.

lines.say: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Psalm ninety, verse fourteen.
lines.big: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

lines.say: Satisfied early means you don't spend the whole day chasing something to fill you.
lines.big: Satisfied early means you don't spend the whole day chasing something to fill you.

lines.say: Lord, fill me with your mercy this morning, so I can be glad all day. In Jesus' name, amen.
